assets.text: For years, a nurse in Australia sat beside people in the final weeks of their lives. <#0.3#> And the number one regret she heard wasn't about money, <#0.2#> or success. <#0.4#> It was this. <#0.3#> I wish I'd had the courage to live a life true to myself, <#0.2#> not the life others expected of me. <#0.5#> The life you're living right now. <#0.3#> Did you really choose it?
